keel_session.original_prompt: a booking website for a small hotel

io_contract.value: Guests open pages to search room availability by date and submit a booking form; the server renders a confirmation page.

runtime.value: A single web server process on one instance.

scale.value: Twelve rooms; a handful of bookings a day.

constraints.value: Server-rendered Python (Flask) with a SQLite file. No build step.

non_goals.value: No web UI or browser-facing pages of any kind; no frontend. Payments are also out of scope.

done.value: A guest can complete a booking end to end in a web browser and see a confirmation page.

data_model.value: Room(id, number, capacity); Booking(id, room_id, guest_name, check_in, check_out, created_at).

interfaces.value: GET /  (availability search), POST /book  (create a booking), GET /booking/<id>  (confirmation).

error_handling.value: An invalid date range re-renders the form with an inline error; a double-booking is rejected with a message.

auth_model.value: No sign-in and no user accounts — everyone using it sees the same data.

seed_data.value: Ships empty; the first user creates all the data.
